about: What a person (or a script playing one) finds and presses on each first-run page, in order. Read by the page tests (ui/src/routes/welcome/welcome.test.ts), ui/e2e/first-run.spec.ts and the installed-app walker (crates/puddle-app/e2e/usable.mjs), so a page that changes here breaks the test of the change that made it. A control is { role, name } as the accessibility tree gives it. `start` is pressed first, and `afterStart` shows up only once the run is done; `continue` goes on to the next page.
